summary: The dogs receive a share from the defeated enemies. This reading of the psalm’s last word is uncertain.

senses.definition: Blood is on the foot of the victor. The dog’s tongue receives its share from the enemies. This is the sole occurrence parsed as this noun.

note: OSHB parses מִנֵּהוּ as a noun with a possessive suffix. Reading the preposition מִן with a suffix gives “from him” or “from it.” The musical term in men-strings and the common preposition in min have other keys. Broad spelling matches in the brief overcount this rare noun.
